player_prompt.intro:
Sika'y Managpapat {player_id} ed sakey a palaro na HighSociety (2-player version).
Daloy na palaro:  Sampulong prestige card so na-auction isa'd sakey.
Panag-auction:    Sakey sakey a auction, pili'en so sikat a kuarta card 1-11 tan ipakita.
            • Mas atakey a bid so manalo na prestige card tan itakewan so kuarta card.
            • Mas baba a bid so manatili so kuarta card da.
            • Tabla -> duaran bids so ibinalik tan say sakey prestige card so na-auction pasen.
Pagscore:    Kayari na sampulong auctions, idagdag **natatag-an kuarta + prestige points**.
            Mas atakey a *net-worth* so manalo (tabla -> tabla).

**Syntax na aksyon**  →  bid sakey a card a singa '[7]' o '[11]'.

board.money_cards: Saray nakekeraan ya kuarta ed saray kard mo: {money}

invalid_move.wrong_format: Nabayaran a mairap na isabi lamang sakey a [X] kuarta a kartas.
invalid_move.card_not_held: Anggapo lay kuarta yo ed satan a card.

message.tie: Tabla - Nabawi so mga bid. Iyabid utro!
message.auction_result: P0 bid {bid0}, P1 bid {bid1}. Managpapat {winner} so manalo na prestige {prize} (total {total}).
